description: Returns the project date membership for the specified company project date on this project.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the company project date.

id.description: ID of the company project date.

project_membership_id.description: ID of the membership linking this project date to the project.

name.description: Display name of the company project date.

date.description: Planned date for this membership on the project.

actual_date.description: Actual date for this membership. Null when not set.

display_on_timeline.description: Whether this date is shown on the project timeline.
